plot: At 2 a.m. on the stove Mr. Pot accuses the Dough Bros of stealing his golden trophy and threatens to fry one loaf per minute; Crispy drags scared Pim through a glitter trail while Zeek's tinfoil fake fails, Crispy hears a rattle and realizes Pot hid it in his own belly, Pim knocks it out, and the engraving reveals it is a reward from the Appliance Club for catching all five bros.

script.title: Who Stole Mr. Pot's Golden Trophy

beats.say: WHERE IS IT?! Who touched my golden trophy?!
Not me! I touch nothing! I don't even touch my own feet!
Two in the morning, on the stove. Mr. Pot's prize trophy is gone, and he has already decided who took it.
Dough Bros. Bring it back by sunrise... or I start frying. One loaf per minute.
Why does it always start with the loaf?!
Because you're the biggest, sweetie. Very fry-able. It's a compliment.
I will find it. Pim comes with me.
Me? Why me? I'm the worst detective in Table Land. I scream at clues.
Screaming is loud. Loud things get noticed. Tonight, we want to be noticed.
And I'll stay here and build a fake trophy. Just in case the real one is gone forever.
Suspect number one. The fridge. Cold, quiet, and full of shiny things.
Shiny spoon. Shiny foil. Shiny... eyeball? THAT'S AN OLIVE. I'm fine. I'm totally fine.
Not here. Too clean, too cold. A thief in a hurry always leaves a trail behind.
A trail! There! Golden glitter on the floor, going all the way back to the stove!
Back toward Mr. Pot himself. Interesting.
Meanwhile, at the stove, Zeek's fake trophy is ready for inspection.
Ninety percent tinfoil, ten percent glue. Nobody could ever tell the difference.
It is made of SANDWICH WRAP. Two minutes left, little triangle.
Eighty-five percent tinfoil. I may have rounded up.
Crispy, the glitter stops right at his feet. Did a mouse steal it? Did a spoon?
Listen carefully. Every time he laughs... something inside him rattles.
Ha ha ha! One more minute, Dough Bros! Ha ha HA!
Rattle, rattle. It came from INSIDE him!
He hid it in his own belly to keep it safe. And then he forgot.
So he wants to fry us... for something he lost inside himself?!
Thirty seconds! Somebody do something! I'm too young to be croutons!
Pim. Go knock on him. Three times. Loud.
Knock on the GIANT FRYING POT? With my FACE?
With your courage. You have more than you think.
Nobody in Table Land has ever knocked on Mr. Pot. Until tonight.
Mister Pot! Knock! Knock! KNOCK!
My trophy! It was... in my tummy? Oh. Oh, that is very embarrassing.
Say sorry to the bean. Right now. NOW!
...Sorry, little bean.
He said sorry! To ME! I'm a hero! I'm going to faint now.
Pick him up. Everybody run while the big guy is polishing!
Shiny... so shiny... hm? What is this writing on the bottom?
Crispy, I scanned the trophy when it fell out. There's an engraving. A new one.
Read it. Slowly. Every word.
Prize for the first appliance who catches all five Dough Bros. Signed, the Appliance Club.
It was never a trophy. It is a reward. And every appliance in this kitchen wants it.

long.title: Who Stole Mr. Pot's Golden Trophy? 🏆
